Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Rafferty
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 233 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, the State General Fund, and to cities and counties by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of diapers and feminine hygiene products purchased for personal use and the applicable sales tax rate.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
